framework.name: Oregon Education Plan and Profile (EPP)
framework.description: Oregon's Education Plan and Profile and the related Personalized Learning requirements for grades 7-12 (OAR 581-022-2000 and ODE's EPP guidance, read 2026-11-02). Codes are stable: the EPP report finds a student's work by these codes, so a district's own steps linked to the same requirement fill the same place in the report. Keep codes when editing; add new requirements with new codes. Graduation credits and Essential Skills are not here: the course plan and SB 3 framework cover those. Titles paraphrase the rule; ODE's text controls.

nodes.title: Personal, academic and career interests
nodes.description: EPP component 1: the student describes their interests, strengths and the careers they're exploring.

nodes.title: Reflect on interest and career assessments
nodes.description: What the student learned from assessments they took this year.

nodes.title: Goals and plan after high school
nodes.description: EPP component 2: long- and short-term goals for post-high-school next steps, reviewed at least yearly.

nodes.title: Choose an education or training path after high school
Identify what it takes to get there
nodes.description: The preparation the student's goals require: courses, tests, applications, money, experience.

nodes.title: Course of study
nodes.description: EPP component 3: design and monitor a course of study toward graduation and the student's goals.

nodes.title: Plan courses toward graduation and goals
Progress toward graduation
nodes.description: EPP component 4: monitor progress toward graduation at least yearly, with an adult.

nodes.title: Review progress with an adult this year
nodes.description: The annual review. Staff mark it done after meeting the student.

nodes.title: Personal accomplishments
nodes.description: EPP component 5: document personal accomplishments, with evidence the student chooses.

nodes.title: Reflect on this year's learning and achievements
Career-related learning experiences
nodes.description: Personalized Learning: participate in career-related learning experiences (CRLEs) connected to the education plan.

nodes.title: Take part in a career-related learning experience
Reflect on a career-related learning experience
Extended Application
nodes.description: Personalized Learning: apply and extend knowledge in new and complex situations related to personal and career interests and post-high-school goals, assessed by the school.

nodes.title: Complete an Extended Application collection of evidence
